_about: Written 14 Nov 2026, 'The Winter Hut at Kell Pass' (3 chapters, 6 planted mistakes, 3 traps). Written by the assistant who knows which kinds of mistake the checks cover, so it is NOT held out.

planted.description: Mira has brown eyes (ch1) but grey eyes (ch3).
Anselm's stiff leg is the left (ch1, ch2) but the right (ch3).
Dr. Hartnoll died instantly in the avalanche (ch2) but ladles soup on Sunday (ch3).
The radio was smashed beyond repair (ch2) but Anselm uses it to call the valley (ch3).
Jonas's ankle is broken, splinted, no weight for four weeks (ch2) but he runs across the ridge (ch3).
Mira is thirty-one (ch1) but thirty-six (ch3), within the same weekend.

decoys.description: Anselm's grey beard (ch1) is 'white with frost' (ch3): frost, not a change.
Mira at twenty-two in her first winter (ch3 flashback): consistent with thirty-one and nine years of clinic work.
Mira's red scarf (ch1) is used as a splint strip (ch2): used, not contradicted.
